description: This file contains utility functions and classes for YOLO object detection, including bounding box processing, image preprocessing, and detection post-processing, using TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, and NumPy.

classes.name: BoundBox
classes.description: Class representing a bounding box with coordinates, objectness score, class probabilities, and methods to get label and score.

methods.name: yolo_head
methods.description: Calculates bounding box parameters from network features, anchors, and input shape.

methods.name: yolo_correct_boxes
methods.description: Adjusts bounding boxes to match original image size after resizing.

methods.name: yolo_boxes_and_scores
methods.description: Generates bounding boxes and their scores from network features.

methods.name: yolo_eval
methods.description: Performs non-max suppression and filters bounding boxes based on thresholds.

methods.name: letterbox_image
methods.description: Resizes and pads an image to fit a target size while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: correct_yolo_boxes
methods.description: Corrects bounding box coordinates to match original image size.

methods.name: retrieve_yolo_detections
methods.description: Decodes network outputs into detection results with labels and bounding box points.

methods.name: draw_boxes
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels on an image.

methods.name: decode_netout
methods.description: Decodes raw network output into bounding box objects.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Preprocesses an image for YOLO input, resizing and normalizing.

methods.name: do_nms
methods.description: Performs non-max suppression on a list of bounding boxes.

methods.name: bbox_iou
methods.description: Calculates Intersection over Union (IoU) between two bounding boxes.
